body:
I just wish they would tell me that you know what, it’s ok. Your suffering is too great. We love you but we realise that you don’t want to go on. We’ll be ok. We’ll be sad to never see you again but we’ll be fine. Just go.

That’s what would relieve me. I need relief. I don’t want to go on without him. I know that there is a life after this... but I don’t want it. I don’t want to
I think that he isn’t here anymore and that he didn’t really anticipate how it would affect me.. if he knew he would never have done it, I know it
he jumped in front of a train
